method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the negatives rulings of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; focus: the provisions a claimant meets. A seat-neutral core (qira-claims.l4, four regulative rules; a deadline for something the employee chooses to do is a DO rule, never a breach), date helpers (qira-dates.l4) and a seat layer (qira-seat.l4, 25 exported questions) that restates no rule; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Industrial Relations Act 2016 (Qld) (act-2016-063), current in-force version on 22 September 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2016-063.txt. The Industrial Relations Regulation 2018 is not deposited; the high income threshold (Fair Work Act 2009 (Cwlth) s 333) and the value of a penalty unit (Penalties and Sentences Act 1992 (Qld)) are inputs.

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run qira-dates.l4 ; l4 run qira-claims.l4 ; l4 run qira-seat.l4 ; l4 run qira-cases-employee.l4
checks.result: 117 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-11-07); 3 #TRACEs with an expect line (1 breach; 2 rules left open with no breach), each read and as expected
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the employee bringing a claim: ss 120-124 (notice of termination, dismissal for misconduct, the 6-year limit, minimum notice, compensation instead of notice); ss 125-127 (redundancy pay); s 310 (general protections time limits); ch 8 pt 2 whole: ss 315-317, 318(4), 320, 322, 323(1)(a)(i), 325-333 (exclusions, unfair dismissal, application, rejection and insistence, lapse, matters considered, compensation cap, severance and mass dismissal orders and their times, stand-down), with ss 318-319, 321, 324, 334-335 (the commission's process) not encoded; s 373(1) (wages monthly); s 376(2)-(3) (overpayment deductions); s 379 (recovery before a magistrate); s 396 (superannuation, time limit); ss 475-477 (the commission's unpaid wages jurisdiction). Out: the rest of ch 2 (leave and other entitlements), the general protections themselves (ch 8 pt 1 divs 1-7) and ss 311-314, ss 371-372, 373(2)-(5), 374-375, 377, 380, clothing outworkers and rural and mining wages, ss 394-395, fair work claims (ch 11 pt 3 div 4), appeals, civil penalties, courier contracts, organisations and transitional chapters.
seat: the employee (or former employee) bringing or weighing a claim against the employer
seats: the employee (or former employee) bringing or weighing a claim against the employer
